description: Microgravity combustion test points from NASA experiments (Saffire, BASS, BASS-II, FLEX) for an O2 % vs flow velocity map, plus reference limits and mission atmosphere presets. Values are taken from the cited pages; nothing is interpolated. See flammability-points-notes.md.

outcome.extinguished: flame went out during the test because of the flow/O2 condition (quenching at low flow or blowoff at high flow)
outcome.did_not_burn: igniter fired but the material did not sustain a flame
outcome.near_limit: flame burned briefly or weakly and the authors describe the condition as at/near the flammability limit

data_quality.reported: number stated in the source text or table
data_quality.read_from_figure: read by eye from a plot, about +/-0.1 mm/s and +/-1 cm/s

enums.flow_direction: concurrent = flow in the same direction as flame spread; opposed = flow against the spread
